# Temple Scroll Column 42 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 42 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**42:1** A clean person shall sprinkle the impure on the third day and the seventh day, purifying him on the seventh day.

**42:2** The one who sprinkles the purification water shall wash his garments; whoever touches the purification water shall be impure until evening.

**42:3** Whatever the impure person touches shall become impure; the person who touches it shall be impure until evening.

**42:4** In every house that the impure person enters, everything within shall be impure for seven days.

**42:5** Every open vessel that lacks a fastened cover shall be impure.

**42:6** He shall be purified on the seventh day; he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be clean at evening.

**42:7** Any person who touches a human bone, a slain person, one who has died, or a grave in the open field shall be impure for seven days.

**42:8** They shall perform for him the complete statute of purification; he shall be sprinkled on the third day and on the seventh day.

**42:9** On the seventh day he shall be clean; he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and at sunset he shall be clean.

**42:10** Anyone who is impure in the open field and does not undergo purification — his impurity persists upon him, and whoever touches him shall be impure.

**42:11** Whoever touches the impure person shall be impure until evening; and the one who sprinkles the purification water shall wash his garments.

**42:12** Whoever touches the purification water shall be impure until evening; and anything that the impure person contacts shall become impure.

**42:13** The person who touches it shall wash his garments and bathe in water and remain impure until evening.

**42:14** The children of Israel shall observe all these statutes, that they may not defile their camps, in the midst of which I dwell.

**42:15** For I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel; therefore you shall consecrate your camps and render them holy.

**42:16** You shall not make your camps abominable with any impure thing, for I am the LORD who dwells in your midst.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 42 elaborates the contagion dynamics of corpse impurity (cf. Numbers 19:17-22). The theological conclusion (vv. 14-16) grounds purity legislation in the doctrine of divine indwelling — God's presence among the people necessitates rigorous purification. "Consecrate" in v. 15 renders qiddesh, indicating active sanctification of communal space.*
